item.title: Kirki WordPress Plugin Password-Reset Hijack Leading to Account Takeover (CVE-2026-8206)

Field Value

Language / Platform PHP / WordPress
Authentication Required No

Summary

The Kirki plugin’s CompLibFormHandler REST API endpoint, used by a Kirki-rendered “forgot password” form, does not properly bind the password-reset request to the account that initiated it. This allows an unauthenticated attacker to redirect the password-reset email/notification for an arbitrary registered WordPress user to an attacker-controlled email address, letting the attacker complete the reset flow and take over the account — without ever needing the victim’s original credentials.
